scope: Diagnostic-only target overlay; unchanged candidate application JAR; probes arm after graphics warmup. Thread CPU/body elapsed clocks exclude their own begin/end accounting I/O. JFR whitelist excludes environment, system properties, process lists and heap content. No recorder. This instrumented run is not a matched performance trial.
